title: A scalar primitive with exponentially decaying derivative has a common strip limit
statement: Let n∈ℕ and a,D,L,y₀∈ℝ satisfy a>0, D≥0, L≥0, and y₀≥1. Let F,H:ℂ→ℂ. Assume H is continuous on {z:Im z>0}, F has complex derivative H(z) at every point of this open half-plane, and |H(z)|≤D(1+Im z)^n exp(−a Im z) whenever 0≤Re z≤L and Im z≥y₀. Set J=∫_(0,∞)(1+s)^n exp(−as)ds with respect to real Lebesgue measure. Then there exists b∈ℂ such that |F(z)−b|≤DJ(1+Im z)^n exp(−a Im z) throughout that strip.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a D L y₀ : ℝ) (F H : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < a → 0 ≤ D → 0 ≤ L → 1 ≤ y₀ → ContinuousOn H {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt F (H z) z) → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ L → y₀ ≤ z.im → ‖H z‖ ≤ D * (1 + z.im) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * z.im)) → ∃ b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ L → y₀ ≤ z.im → ‖F z - b‖ ≤ (D * (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (1 + s) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * s))) * (1 + z.im) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * z.im)
